source.data: ONT methylation benchmark (Sowpati lab, AWS Open Data: ont-basemod-benchmark-data), E. coli dam-/dcm- (DM) and DM + M.SssI (all CpG methylated), R10.4.1, 5 kHz
source.labels: Reference base at the window centre (pore orientation); signal located via Dorado sup v5.2.0 move tables
source.split: ML models trained on reads aligned to the first half of the genome; all windows here come from the second half
source.easiness: CNN probability of the true base (0–100), used to order training easy → hard
source.kmer: expected current per 5-mer (bases j−2…j+2), mean over the training half of the genome
source.window: 161 samples (≈13 bases) centred on the base midpoint; highlighted band is a fixed ±6 samples

models.name: level
models.label: Level only
models.description: Logistic regression on the highlighted stretch's mean current and spread — the 'eyeball the level' strategy.

models.name: knn
models.label: Nearest neighbours
models.description: Finds the 25 most similar labelled traces (of 60,000) and takes a vote.

models.name: logreg
models.label: Logistic regression
models.description: A linear model on the whole window.

models.name: cnn
models.label: 1D CNN
models.description: A small convolutional network trained on ~200,000 windows. Sees only this window, like you.

models.name: fast
models.label: Dorado fast
models.description: Oxford Nanopore's fast basecaller (v5.2.0). Sees the whole read.

models.name: hac
models.label: Dorado hac
models.description: High-accuracy basecaller (v5.2.0). Sees the whole read.

models.name: sup
models.label: Dorado sup
models.description: Super-accuracy basecaller (v5.2.0), the state of the art. Sees the whole read.
